voxy.config.title: Voxy
voxy.config.general.enabled.tooltip: Fully awakeneth or putteth to sleep this engine of Voxy, according to thy desire
voxy.config.general.serviceThreads.toolt: The multitude of cords wherewith the Great Pool of Ministry (ServiceThreadPool) may labor
voxy.config.general.useSodiumBuilder.too: Weaveth the mason-threads of Sodium into Voxy’s own loom. It stayeth the faltering and halting of thy vision when thou movest with swiftness across vast distances
voxy.config.general.ingest.tooltip: Granteth or denieth unto Voxy the power to receive new-born chunks and fashion them into distant resemblances (LoDs)
voxy.config.general.rendering.tooltip: Commandeth whether Voxy shall bring forth its imagery or keep it hid
voxy.config.general.subDivisionSize.tool: The greatest measure of pixels squared upon the canvas before it be rent into smaller LoDs. A lesser measure bringeth forth a more glorious aspect
voxy.config.general.renderDistance.toolt: How many leagues of chunks Voxy’s eye may pierce on the horizon
voxy.config.general.environmental_fog.to: Suffereth or forbiddeth the mist of the firmament to be rendered by Voxy
voxy.config.general.ssao_mode.tooltip: The manner whereby shadows are cast into the clefts of the world. (The Choice of 'Auto' seeketh the fairest look whilst sparing thy machine from heavy travail)
